title: Per-request `_meta`
description: The required request metadata carrying protocol version, client capabilities and client identity on every single request, replacing connection state.
question: Does every request the framework sends carry the required metadata?
why: This is the structural change of 2026-07-28: MCP is stateless, and the handshake that used to negotiate once per connection is gone. A framework still modelling a session sends requests the server must reject with `UnsupportedProtocolVersionError`, and this row is the difference between an adapter that was ported to this revision and one that was merely pointed at it.
known_issues: Measured by scripts/measure_protocol.py: each adapter runs against fixtures/base_protocol_server.py behind the wire recorder, and the cell is read from the captures.
